label: Housing acquisition tax rate
unit: % of the acquisition price, individual buyer
appliesTo: Individuals acquiring housing for consideration. Multiple owners and companies are on a separate, heavier schedule.
why: The single largest cash cost at completion, and the most politically active number in Korean property. Nationality does not change it — what does is the buyer, the number of homes held, the price, the region and the nature of the dwelling.

history.note: Local education tax on top, and rural special tax where the exclusive floor area exceeds 85㎡.
